title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ThirdCountryDataTransfer
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ThirdCountryDataTransfer. Specifies data transfer to a third country with relevant securing mechanisms. Subclass of DataTransfer per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataTransfer model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ThirdCountryDataTransfer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

country.description: Property. Country to which the data can be transferred (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).

securingMechanism.description: Property. Mechanism(s) used to secure the data transfer.
